name: Duratec Limited
summary: Duratec Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of assessment, protection, remediation, and refurbishment services to a range of assets primarily for steel and concrete infrastructure in Australia. It operates through Defence, Mining & Industrial, Building & Façade, and Energy segments. The Defence segment delivers capital facilities, infrastructure, and estate works program projects. The Mining & Industrial segment offers preventative maintenance programmes. The Building & Facade segment provides facade condition assessments and restorations services.
